note: Oil and gas extended their slide into 10 November: Brent fell to about $90.47/bbl, WTI to about $85.17/bbl and TTF to about €82.63/MWh, all down 13-15% from a week earlier, continuing the pullback since Iraq said it reached understandings with the US to keep exporting through Hormuz and traders sought US licenses to return sanctioned tankers to legitimate trade. No new escalation was reported Monday; the IMO instead called for stronger protection of merchant crews given the rising toll from attacks near Hormuz, the Red Sea and the Black Sea.
